text: The subject Imran Shafiq holds account PK**MUCB****9020 which was opened on 20 July 2021. The subject is declared as a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month. During the activity window from 2 June 2026 to 30 June 2026 the account recorded 17 credits totalling PKR 28,028,000 and 6 debits totalling PKR 26,397,000. Within that period 16 cash deposits totalling PKR 27,878,000 were made across three branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Saddar Branch). The activity was flagged by Tazama on 30 June 2026, with the Tazama typology STR-PK-01 scoring 320 against an alert threshold of 300. Fifteen of the sixteen cash deposits (94%) were between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, i.e., just below the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000, which is indicative of structuring. The deposits were spread across three branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Saddar Branch), consistent with a structuring pattern. More than one cash deposit on 8 June 2026 and 21 June 2026 is consistent with structuring indicators. The total credits were 186.9 times the declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month, suggesting cash volume inconsistent with the declared income and consistent with structuring. The branch note dated 14 June 2026 recording the customer’s question about why deposits of PKR 2 million or more require extra paperwork and the refusal to explain the cash source is suspected to be indicative of structuring. Overall, the pattern of numerous near‑threshold cash deposits, use of multiple branches, repeated same‑day deposits, and cash volume far exceeding the declared income of PKR 150,000 per month is consistent with suspected structuring. PKR 26,397,000 was transferred to Crescent Imports (PK**CRES****1592, Synthetic Bank A) in six transactions. Debits equal to 94% of credits were executed with a median lag of 26.4 hours after the latest credit, indicating rapid turnover. Screening on 28 June 2026 found no match on sanctions, politically exposed persons or adverse media. The account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
